column1: # Hand labels for sources/measure.py, written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later): the lemma or lemmas a reader most likely
# means by a word whose wty-uk-en rows name two or more lemmas, several only when each reading is common in context.
# Labelled were 483 words: the 366 such words among the 10,000 most frequent words of uk_50k.txt and the words used 15
# times or more in the two Wikisource texts, the words of the whole-word rules of build-own.mjs, and words of the
# measurements' wrong lists and of the reviews, judged in their contexts. Kept here are the labels that change a verdict
# of measure.py on a first result of the five measured rule sets; for the others its frequency proxy gives the same
